title: Build-result card overflows horizontally on mobile — truncate span lacks a min-w-0 flex ancestor
body: Found while fixing #2481 (mobile Live Canvas). Independent, pre-existing, and in a different package. On mobile `/ai/build`, the chat column overflows the viewport horizontally (measured ~672–2128px vs a ~500px viewport). The widest element is: ``` built N artifact(s) — live in your new app, grouped under app.… // scrollWidth ~2128 ``` `truncate` sets `white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis`, but for the ellipsis to constrain layout, a flex ancestor needs `min-w-0` (flex items default to `min-width:auto`, which refuses to shrink below content width). Without it, the nowrap span forces its flex row to content width → the whole chat column grows → the mobile chat scrolls sideways. - Location: the build-result / build-tree card in `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (rendered by `ChatbotEnhanced`). The `built N artifact(s)…` summary line. - Fix: add `min-w-0` to the appropriate flex ancestor(s) of that truncate span (and audit sibling truncate lines in the same card). Verify on both mobile and desktop — desktop has more width so it's latent there. - Not bundled into #2481/#2492 (the Live Canvas split fix) to avoid a cross-package change with desktop-regression risk. Refs #2481
